svg.aria-label: Four failures, one after another. The receiver is down: the message stays saved and lands on a later attempt. A delivery reply is lost: it is sent twice and stored once. The process dies mid-commit: the transaction rolls back and leaves no partial writes. The client never hears back: it retries with the same key and gets the original reply.
